snippet.title: Fool’s Trigger - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
EMBARGO: Please do not publish before October 12, 2026. We will announce this ourselves on October 12. Please confirm the publication slot by email: PodrezCrew@gmail.com.

Fool’s Trigger combines Russian roulette with card tactics. Developed by PodrezCrew, a small indie team, the game launches on Steam on November 26, 2026. We are also planning to take part in October’s Steam Next Fest.

We would be delighted if you shared the trailer with your audience before release. More details about the game and its mechanics are in the PDF included in our English press kit: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1oBw8fgTcLETwK0BhOEcs9e9xdcr67J2P

Thank you for helping us spread the word!
Vladimir Podrez / PodrezCrew

Fool’s Trigger

Wishlist it: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3612300/Fools_Trigger/?utm_source=SM&utm_medium=press&utm_campaign=release_20261126&utm_content=en&utm_term=mundogamer
